I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. 🧅🥓 Bacon-Wrapped Stuffed Onions These Bacon-Wrapped Stuffed Onions are loaded with seasoned ground beef and gooey melted cheese, wrapped in crispy bacon, and grilled or baked until beautifully caramelized. A delicious low-carb comfort food that's perfect for BBQs and family dinners! 🥩 Ingredients 4 large yellow or sweet onions 1½ lbs ground beef 8–12 slices bacon 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon smoked paprika 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ cup BBQ sauce 1 tablespoon olive oil 👩‍🍳 Instructions Prepare the onions: Peel the onions and carefully cut off the tops and bottoms. Remove the inner layers, leaving about 2–3 layers to create sturdy onion shells. Prepare the filling: In a bowl, combine the ground beef, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined. Add the cheese: Mix the shredded cheddar and mozzarella into the seasoned beef. Stuff the onions: Carefully fill each onion shell with the beef and cheese mixture. Press gently so the filling is packed inside. Wrap with bacon: Wrap each stuffed onion with bacon, overlapping the slices slightly. Secure with toothpicks if needed. Add BBQ sauce: Brush each bacon-wrapped onion generously with BBQ sauce. Bake or grill: Oven: Preheat to 375°F (190°C). Place the onions on a foil-lined baking tray and bake for 45–60 minutes, turning or brushing with more BBQ sauce halfway through. Grill: Cook over indirect medium heat for approximately 45–60 minutes, keeping the lid closed as much as possible. Finish until crispy: Brush with another layer of BBQ sauce during the final 10 minutes and cook until the bacon is crisp and the beef reaches a safe internal temperature of 160°F (71°C). Rest and serve: Let the stuffed onions rest for 5–10 minutes, then carefully remove any toothpicks and serve hot. 🔥 Tips Use large onions so there's plenty of room for the filling. Don't pack the beef too tightly or it may take longer to cook. For extra smoky flavor, use smoked cheddar or add a little chipotle seasoning. Add cooked bacon bits to the beef mixture for an extra bacon boost. A meat thermometer is the best way to confirm the beef is fully cooked. 🍽️ Serving Ideas Serve these with grilled vegetables, coleslaw, baked potatoes, a fresh salad, or roasted broccoli. They also make an incredible BBQ or game-day appetizer! #baconwrappedonions #stuffedonions #BaconLoversUnite #groundbeefrecipes #cheesestuffednaan

one of the easiest go to recipes I make all the time when I’m feeling a bit lazy but want something that feels comforting and elevated but not overly complicated! A sausage, fennel and broccoli pasta using white wine as a base with lots of chilli, garlic and lemon. Perfect for midweek!  Ingredients: 250g italian sausages (or any sausage)  150g tender stem broccoli  4 garlic cloves  1 tsp fennel seeds  1 tsp chilli flakes  1/2 a lemon  175ml dry white wine  200g pasta  50g parmesan (more to serve) Method: Remove the sausage meat from its casing and crumble into a pan. Pop onto a medium heat with a little oil to slowly render the fat for a few minutes and then turn it up to get those lovely crispy edges.  Put your pasta on to boil.  Dice shallots and mince garlic and chop the broccoli into a similar size as the sausage crumbles. Add the onion to the sausage pan and cook out for a moment before adding the minced garlic, fennel seeds and chilli flakes. Fry this all off for another minute or two stirring regularly and then pour in the white wine. Let it bubble for a minute and stir so you get all the flavour stuck to the bottom of the pan. Drag your cooked pasta over so some of the water comes with it, mix well and squeeze over lemon juice and add parmesan. Mix well, season to taste and serve with a healthy drizzle of good quality olive oil
